title: Pretraining-Based Natural Language Generation for Text Summarization
answer_short: It allows the decoder to generate more fluent and natural sequences by leveraging BERT's contextualized representations, similar to the cloze task in BERT's pre-training process.
answer_rationale: Masking words in the decoder is helpful because it enables the model to generate more fluent and natural sequences by leveraging BERT's contextualized representations, which is analogous to the cloze task in BERT's pre-training process. This approach allows the decoder to focus on one word at a time, using the source document and other words as context, thereby improving the quality of the generated summary. The refine decoder, which masks each word in the summary draft and predicts a refined word using a Transformer decoder, is designed to mimic BERT's pre-training process and utilize its contextual language modeling ability.
